public_payload.normalized_proposition: The claim that software engineers struggle to find work because AI is replacing them is a lie.

statement.excerpt: This grotesque, abusive, manipulative and offensive lie has been propagated throughout the entire business and tech media without anybody sitting down and asking whether it’s true, or even getting a good understanding of what it is that LLMs can actually do with code.

from_speaker: software engineers are having trouble finding work
because their jobs are being replaced by AI
our_interpretation: Assess the normalized causal proposition about hiring difficulties existing by the post date. No beginning date is supplied.
Lie is read as a false causal explanation, without adding a claim about journalists' private knowledge or intent.
The ordinary question is whether AI substitution materially contributed to hiring difficulties, not whether it explains every missing job.
The separate rhetorical assertion about the entire media is not treated as the normalized claim being graded.
criteria.support_condition: Credible evidence establishes that AI substitution was not a material cause of the described software-engineering hiring difficulties.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible causal research or corroborated employer records establish a material contribution from AI substitution to those difficulties.
